```javascript
function run(testKey,seed0,storeKey){const D=load("wdbc_split"),test=D.test,h=16,d=30,K=2,etaPrep=.05,etaCont=.5,etaB=.5,N=1000,H=200,c=1;let seed=seed0;function u(){seed=(1664525*seed+1013904223)>>>0;return (seed+.5)/4294967296}function n(){return Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(u()))*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*u())}function init(scale){return {A:Array.from({length:h},()=>Array.from({length:d},()=>scale*n())),a:Array(h).fill(0),B:Array.from({length:K},()=>Array.from({length:h},()=>n()/Math.sqrt(h))),b:Array(K).fill(0)}}function fw(m,x){const z=m.A.map((w,j)=>Math.tanh(w.reduce((s,v,l)=>s+v*x[l],m.a[j]))),q=m.B.map((w,k)=>w.reduce((s,v,j)=>s+v*z[j],m.b[k])),mx=Math.max(...q),ex=q.map(v=>Math.exp(v-mx)),sum=ex.reduce((a,b)=>a+b);return {z,q,p:ex.map(v=>v/sum),ls:mx+Math.log(sum)}}function ev(m,data){let L=0;for(const o of data){const f=fw(m,o.x);L+=f.ls-f.q[o.y]}return L/data.length}function step(m,data,etaA){const GA=Array.from({length:h},()=>Array(d).fill(0)),ga=Array(h).fill(0),GB=Array.from({length:K},()=>Array(h).fill(0)),gb=Array(K).fill(0);for(const o of data){const f=fw(m,o.x),p=f.p;p[o.y]-=1;for(let k=0;k<K;k++){gb[k]+=p[k];for(let j=0;j<h;j++)GB[k][j]+=p[k]*f.z[j]}for(let j=0;j<h;j++){let dz=0;for(let k=0;k<K;k++)dz+=m.B[k][j]*p[k];dz*=1-f.z[j]*f.z[j];ga[j]+=dz;for(let l=0;l<d;l++)GA[j][l]+=dz*o.x[l]}}const cA=etaA/data.length,cB=etaB/data.length;for(let j=0;j<h;j++){m.a[j]-=cB*ga[j];for(let l=0;l<d;l++)m.A[j][l]-=cA*GA[j][l]}for(let k=0;k<K;k++){m.b[k]-=cB*gb[k];for(let j=0;j<h;j++)m.B[k][j]-=cB*GB[k][j]}}const selected={S:[],W:[]};for(let i=0;i<N;i++){const scale=u()<.5?.1:1,z=init(scale);for(let e=0;e<5;e++)step(z,D.train,etaPrep);const val=ev(z,D.val),q=Math.floor(val/.05);if(q===2)selected.S.push({i,scale,z,val,g:"S"});else if(q===5&&selected.W.length<100)selected.W.push({i,scale,z,val,g:"W"})}const mu=selected.S.reduce((s,v)=>s+v.val,0)/selected.S.length,targets=[.6,.7,.8].map(z=>z*mu),out=[];for(const v of [...selected.S,...selected.W]){const L0=ev(v.z,test),tt=targets.map(t=>L0<t?0:null);for(let e=1;e<=H;e++){step(v.z,D.train,etaCont);if(tt.every(t=>t!==null))break;const L=ev(v.z,test);for(let j=0;j<3;j++)if(tt[j]===null&&L<targets[j])tt[j]=e}out.push({i:v.i,g:v.g,scale:v.scale,val:v.val,L0,t60:tt[0],t70:tt[1],t80:tt[2]})}store(storeKey,out);function st(g){const a=out.filter(v=>v.g===g),res={n:a.length,L0:a.reduce((s,v)=>s+v.L0,0)/a.length};for(const k of ["t60","t70","t80"]){res[k]=a.reduce((s,v)=>s+(v[k]??201),0)/a.length;res[k+"Censor"]=a.filter(v=>v[k]===null).length}return res}return {targets,S:st("S"),W:st("W")}}
```

执行函数中的q===2/q===5是前一阶段按父页固定自动规则、只根据同批准备后验证分箱得出的实际箱号；两个候选种子均选出相同箱号。测试集未参与这个决定。完整可复现实现应把分箱扫描与续训封装成单一脚本，而不是依赖当前会话的分阶段执行。

e=0;e<5;e++)step(z,D.train,etaPrep);const val=ev(z,D.val);let gate=0;for(const o of D.val)for(let j=0;j<h;j++){let q=z.a[j];for(let l=0;l<d;l++)q+=z.A[j][l]*o.x[l];let t=Math.tanh(q);gate+=1-t*t}gate/=D.val.length*h;pool.push({i,scale,z,val,gate})}const qs=[...new Set(pool.map(v=>Math.floor(v.val/.05)))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),sbin=qs.find(q=>pool.filter(v=>Math.floor(v.val/.05)===q&&v.gate<.5).length>=20),wbin=qs.find(q=>q>sbin&&pool.filter(v=>Math.floor(v.val/.05)===q&&v.gate>=.5).length>=20),selected={S:pool.filter(v=>Math.floor(v.val/.05)===sbin&&v.gate<.5).map(v=>({...v,g:"S"})),W:pool.filter(v=>Math.floor(v.val/.05)===wbin&&v.gate>=.5).slice(0,100).map(v=>({...v,g:"W"}))};const mu=selected.S.reduce((s,v)=>s+v.val,0)/selected.S.length,targets=[.6,.7,.8].map(z=>z*mu),out=[];for(const v of [...selected.S,...selected.W]){const j=0;j<3;j++)if(tt[j]===null&&L<targets[j])tt[j]=e}out.push({i:v.i,g:v.g,scale:v.scale,val:v.val,L0,t60:tt[0],t70:tt[1],t80:tt[2]})}store(storeKey,out);function st(g){const
